亚马逊 SageMaker AI 的无服务模型定制服务迎来了重大更新，在原本支持的 LoRA 等高效微调方法之外，正式加入了对全参数微调（FFT）的支持。传统的 LoRA 方法通过冻结预训练权重并注入小型矩阵来减少参数，但在处理复杂任务时容易遇到准确率瓶颈。相比之下，**FFT 会同时更新所有模型参数**，利用网络的完整表征能力，实现更强的模型收敛性。

为了对比效果，AWS 团队使用 Qwen3-4B 基础模型和 11 万条代码指令数据集进行了测试。实验显示，当训练数据超过 10 万条时，**FFT 在语义正确性**和文本相似度指标上明显优于 LoRA。不过，FFT 也带来了更严重的灾难性遗忘风险，因此需要仔细调整学习率和训练轮数，以平衡领域适应与通用知识的保留。

en.title: Exa Boosts Web Embedding Throughput by 50% on AWS AI Chips
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Web search startup **Exa reports** a 47% improvement in embedding performance and cost efficiency when indexing billions of documents on AWS Inferentia2 chips. By combining **custom hardware kernels** and automated agentic development workflows, the team successfully eliminated memory bottlenecks and hardware contention.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

To build a true web index for semantic search and AI agents, Exa must embed tens of billions of documents into a vector database. Facing doubled inference loads during a major corpus migration, Exa optimized its machine learning pipeline on AWS Neuron hardware, including Inferentia2 and Trainium2 chips. 

Starting from a baseline FP16 model, the engineering team applied several progressive optimizations. They utilized weight layout adjustments, autocast precision downcasting while maintaining a strict correctness threshold of 0.999 cosine similarity, and drop-in NKI kernels. To address memory spill and hardware core contention, **Exa developed custom kernels** including a fused SwiGLU MLP kernel and shape-tailored attention operations to reduce redundant floating-point operations. 

These optimizations were largely driven by an automated, agentic development workflow built on Flyte. Different AI models handled distinct tasks within a testing harness, ranging from compiler parameter tuning to writing complex custom kernels, ultimately delivering a **1.5x throughput improvement** over the initial baseline.

zh.title: Exa 借助亚马逊 AI 芯片将网页向量化吞吐量提升 50%
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：网页搜索初创公司 **Exa 报告称**，在亚马逊 AWS Inferentia2 芯片上处理数十亿网页文档时，其向量化性能与成本效率提升了 47%。通过结合**定制硬件内核**与自动化智能体开发工作流，团队成功消除了内存瓶颈与硬件算力冲突。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

为了构建用于语义搜索和人工智能代理的真实网页索引，Exa 需要将数百亿个文档转化为向量存入数据库。在面对大规模语料库迁移期间翻倍的推理负载时，Exa 在亚马逊 AWS Neuron 硬件（包括 Inferentia2 和 Trainium2 芯片）上对其机器学习流水线进行了深度优化。

从基础的 FP16 模型开始，工程团队实施了一系列渐进式优化。他们调整了权重布局，在保持 0.999 余弦相似度的严格准确性阈值的同时，利用自动混合精度下转降低计算开销，并引入了 Neuron 内核接口（NKI）的现成模块。为了解决内存溢出和硬件核心争用问题，**Exa 开发了定制内核**，包括融合的 SwiGLU 多层感知机内核以及针对模型具体形状定制的注意力机制操作，从而显著减少了冗余的浮点运算。

这些优化在很大程度上得益于基于 Flyte 构建的自动化智能体开发工作流。不同的 AI 模型在测试框架中分工协作，从编译器参数微调到编写复杂的自定义内核，最终实现了较初始基准 **1.5 倍的吞吐量提升**。

en.title: Humyn Labs raises $47M to provide real-world training data for robots
en.summary: Physical AI startup **Humyn Labs** announced a **$47 million Series A** funding round, combining equity and venture debt. The company captures real-world data across vision, sound, touch, and motion in **over 20 countries** to help robotics companies transition from simulated environments to practical deployments.
en.full_summary:
## Funding Details and Revenue Growth
Physical AI research and deployment company Humyn Labs reported raising $47 million in its Series A funding round, which includes $26 million in equity led by Accel and $21 million in venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton. Co-founder Ishank Gupta stated that the company has surpassed **$50 million in annualized revenue** within six months of operation.

## Data Collection across Four Modalities
Humyn Labs addresses a major industry bottleneck by helping roboticists bridge the gap between lab simulations and real-world execution. The company gathers data across **vision, sound, touch, and motion** using proprietary capture devices operated in over 20 countries, with a primary focus on Latin America, South Asia, Southeast Asia, and East Asia. Their end-to-end data engine converts human job performance into labelled, training-ready datasets tailored to researchers' needs.

## Deployment Infrastructure Plans
The newly secured capital will be allocated toward three key areas: building deployment readiness infrastructure in **Brazil, Korea, and India**; advancing their capture hardware and enrichment engine; and expanding their on-the-ground presence in San Francisco, London, and Seoul to save research labs from the logistical burdens of data collection.

zh.title: Humyn Labs获4700万美元融资，为机器人提供真实世界训练数据
zh.summary: 物理人工智能初创公司 **Humyn Labs** 宣布完成总计 **4700万美元** 的A轮融资（含股权与债权）。该公司通过在 **20多个国家** 采集视觉、声音、触觉和运动等真实世界数据，帮助机器人企业解决从虚拟仿真走向实际落地的难题。
zh.full_summary:
## 融资详情与营收增长
物理人工智能研究与部署公司 Humyn Labs 宣布完成 4700 万美元的 A 轮融资，其中包括由 Accel 领投的 2600 万美元股权融资，以及由 Lighthouse Canton 领投的 2100 万美元风险债融资。联合创始人 Ishank Gupta 表示，公司在运营短短六个月内，**年度化营收已突破 5000 万美元**。

## 四大模态的数据采集
Humyn Labs 致力于解决机器人行业的一大痛点，即如何将实验室的模拟环境转化为现实世界的实际应用。该公司利用自主研发的采集设备，在 **20多个国家** 收集视觉、声音、触觉和运动数据，其业务重点分布在拉丁美洲、南亚、东南亚和东亚。他们通过端到端的数据引擎，将人类的工作过程转化为符合研究人员需求的标注化、可直接用于训练的数据集。

## 资金用途与基础设施建设
这笔新资金将主要用于三个方面：在**巴西、韩国和印度**建立部署就绪的基础设施；升级其捕获硬件和数据增强引擎；以及扩大其在旧金山、伦敦和首尔的实地业务存在，从而让顶尖研究实验室免受繁琐的数据收集工作困扰。

en.title: Cloudflare Releases Updated Open-Weight Clairic and Clairic-Flash Models
en.summary: According to Cloudflare AI: Cloudflare has introduced **updated open-weight** models named Clairic and Clairic-flash for text and document extraction. The redesigned architecture significantly improves accuracy and speed while supporting **complex document formats** like PDFs and images. Both models are now available on Workers AI and Hugging Face.
en.full_summary:
According to Cloudflare AI:

## Background
Cloudflare's Workers AI superintelligence team is developing frontier AI models targeted at customer workflows and the open-source community, focusing specifically on data extraction challenges.

## Architecture and Performance
According to Cloudflare, the updated Clairic (a 27B model) and the new Clairic-flash (a 9-billion-parameter model) utilize a redesigned architecture featuring **parallel slot autoregressive generation** instead of single forward passes. This enables faster response times under one second and improved handling of unstructured text, images, and multi-page PDFs.

## Pricing and Availability
Both models are hosted on Workers AI and released with open weights on Hugging Face. Cloudflare is offering a promotional price of $0.10 per million input tokens for both models until December 1, 2026, after which the 27B Clairic model will transition to $0.24 per million input tokens.

zh.title: Cloudflare 发布全新开源权重的 Clairic 与 Clairic-flash 模型
zh.summary: 据Cloudflare AI发布的信息：Cloudflare 推出了用于文本和文档提取的 **更新版开源权重** 模型 Clairic 和 Clairic-flash。其重新设计的架构显著提升了准确率与速度，并支持 PDF 和图像等 **复杂文档格式**。两款模型目前已上线 Workers AI 与 Hugging Face。
zh.full_summary:
据Cloudflare AI发布的信息：

## 背景与定位
Cloudflare 的 Workers AI 超级智能团队正在开发面向客户和开源社区的前沿 AI 模型，重点解决结构化数据提取的痛点。

## 架构与性能改进
据 Cloudflare 称，升级后的 Clairic（27B 模型）与全新的 Clairic-flash（90 亿参数模型）采用了 **并行槽自回归生成** 的全新架构，摒弃了传统单次前向传递。这使得模型在处理非结构化文本、图像及多页 PDF 时，能够实现亚秒级的响应速度并显著提高准确率。

## 价格与开源
这两款模型均已在 Workers AI 托管，并在 Hugging Face 上发布了 **开源权重**。在 2026 年 12 月 1 日之前，Cloudflare 为两款模型提供每百万输入 Token 0.10 美元的限时优惠价，之后 27B 的 Clairic 模型将恢复为 0.24 美元。

en.title: DaisyRose-27B: A New AI Model That Learns from Long Tasks to Boost Coding and Reasoning
en.summary: RadixArk reports the release of **DaisyRose-27B**, a new AI model built on Qwen3.8-27B using reinforcement learning. Trained on long-horizon agent tasks with sessions up to 1M tokens, it **improves Terminal-Bench 4.1** from 5.6% to 12.0% and is available under the Apache 2.0 license.
en.full_summary:
## Training Data and Setup
RadixArk reports that DaisyRose-27B was trained in partnership with Eigent AI using around **1,200 curated tasks**. The training process leveraged 144 H200 GPUs over 18 days, focusing on long-horizon agent tasks where each attempt could spend up to 1.5 hours in a sandbox environment with extensive tool calls.

## Backend Efficiency
According to RadixArk, the model was trained using its internal reinforcement learning framework, Miles, in a fully asynchronous mode. The setup achieved **57% lower training cost** compared to standard open-source trainers, running at about 16,800 tokens per second across the 144 GPUs.

## Benchmark Performance
RadixArk states that DaisyRose-27B outperforms the original Qwen3.8-27B across various benchmarks, including coding, instruction following, and reasoning. The model retains a **256K-token context window** and supports BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 formats.

zh.title: DaisyRose-27B：通过长任务强化学习大幅提升编程与推理能力的新AI模型
zh.summary: RadixArk 宣布推出基于 Qwen3.8-27B 改进的新模型 **DaisyRose-27B**。通过针对长任务的强化学习训练，它在多个基准测试中表现提升，其中 **Terminal-Bench 4.1 成绩**从 5.6% 跃升至 12.0%，相关权重已在 Apache 2.0 协议下开源。
zh.full_summary:
## 训练数据与任务设计
据 RadixArk 称，DaisyRose-27B 与 Eigent AI 合作开发，使用约 **1,200 个精选任务**进行训练。该项目在 144 张 H200 GPU 上耗时 18 天完成，专注于需要长时间多步骤规划和工具调用的复杂智能体任务。

## 训练效率与后端表现
RadixArk 报告称，其团队使用自研的 Miles 强化学习框架进行全异步训练。相比开源训练方案，该后端实现了 **57% 的训练成本降低**，在 144 张 GPU 上达到了每秒约 16,800 个token的处理速度。

## 性能表现与开源情况
根据官方公布的数据，DaisyRose-27B 在编程、指令遵循和复杂推理等多个基准测试中均超越了原版 Qwen3.8-27B。该模型保留了 **256K的上下文窗口**，并提供 BF16、FP8 和 NVFP4 等多种格式供开发者使用。

en.title: CTAD 2026: Biogen, AriBio and others share new Alzheimer's drug trial results
en.summary: At the 2026 Clinical Trials on Alzheimer’s Disease conference, drug developers shared new data on various experimental treatments. **Biogen** reported that its anti-tau therapy diranersen slowed cognitive decline by 38% at two years in a mid-stage study. Meanwhile, South Korea's **AriBio** announced that its oral drug candidate AR1001 achieved a 31% slowing of clinical decline in a specific monotherapy patient group during a Phase 3 trial.
en.full_summary:
Researchers and biopharma companies gathered in Boston for the 2026 Clinical Trials on Alzheimer’s Disease conference to discuss treatments moving beyond traditional amyloid approaches. 

**Biogen's anti-tau therapy**
Biogen presented two-year data from the Phase 2 CELIA study of diranersen, an antisense oligonucleotide developed with Ionis. According to BMO Capital Markets and Jefferies, the low-dose regimen slowed clinical decline by 38% on a key scale. Although the trial missed its primary endpoint regarding statistically significant dose responses, analysts and trial investigators noted that the growing separation between treated and placebo groups over time supports advancing the asset into Phase 3.

**AriBio's Phase 3 success**
AriBio reported that its oral PDE5 inhibitor, AR1001, met its primary efficacy objective in a prespecified monotherapy population during a Phase 3 trial. Among 604 patients taking the drug alone, cognitive decline slowed by 31% compared to placebo. While the overall trial population of 1,535 patients did not show a statistically significant effect, the company plans to discuss the monotherapy results with the FDA.

**Other pipeline updates**
German biotech Priavoid reported that its oral amyloid-targeting drug PRI-002 missed its primary efficacy endpoint in a Phase 3 trial, though a small subgroup showed slower decline over 72 weeks. Additionally, Cognito Therapeutics plans to consult the FDA regarding its at-home light and sound stimulation platform, Spectris AD, which missed its primary endpoint in a Phase 3 study but showed a nominal signal in a mild Alzheimer's subgroup.

zh.title: CTAD 2026：Biogen与AriBio等药企公布最新阿尔茨海默病药物试验结果
zh.summary: 在2026年阿尔茨海默病临床试验大会上，各大药企公布了多项实验性疗法的最新数据。**Biogen**报告称，其抗tau蛋白疗法diranersen在中期试验中显示，两年内可使认知功能下降速度减缓38%。与此同时，韩国药企**AriBio**宣布其口服候选药物AR1001在一项三期试验的特定单药治疗患者群体中，使临床病情恶化速度减慢了31%。
zh.full_summary:
研究人员和生物制药公司齐聚波士顿参加2026年阿尔茨海默病临床试验大会，探讨超越传统淀粉样蛋白靶点的创新疗法。

**Biogen的抗tau疗法进展**
Biogen公布了与其合作伙伴Ionis共同开发的抗tau药物diranersen的二期CELIA研究两年期数据。据分析机构指出，低剂量方案在关键量表上使临床病情恶化速度减缓了38%。尽管该试验未达到关于剂量反应的主要终点，但研究人员和分析师认为，随着时间推移，治疗组和安慰剂组之间的差距逐渐扩大，这支持该药物进入三期临床试验。

**AriBio的三期试验成功**
韩国生物科技公司AriBio报告称，其口服PDE5抑制剂AR1001在三期试验中达到了预先指定的单药治疗人群的主要疗效目标。在604名单药治疗患者中，该药物使认知下降速度比安慰剂组减慢了31%。尽管包含1,535名患者的总体试验人群未表现出统计学显著效果，但该公司计划与FDA就单药治疗结果进行沟通。

**其他管线动态**
德国生物技术公司Priavoid报告称，其口服抗淀粉样蛋白药物PRI-002在一项中期试验中未能达到主要疗效终点，不过一个小型亚组在72周内显示出较慢的病情恶化速度。此外，Cognito Therapeutics计划就其居家光声刺激平台Spectris AD向FDA咨询潜在的获批路径，该设备在一项三期研究中未达到主要终点，但在轻度阿尔茨海默病亚组中显示出名义上的信号。

en.title: Databricks Brings Governed AI Assistant Genie to Microsoft Teams, Excel, and Copilot
en.summary: According to Databricks: Databricks announces that its **Genie AI assistant** is now integrated into everyday Microsoft tools like Teams, Excel, and Copilot Cowork. Powered by **Genie Ontology** and Unity Catalog, the integration ensures business users get accurate, secure answers grounded in unified corporate data rather than guessing from raw table names.
en.full_summary:
According to Databricks:

Databricks is expanding the reach of its AI assistant, Genie, by bringing it directly into the Microsoft ecosystem. Business users often struggle with AI assistants that lack proper business context, leading to inconsistent metrics and untrusted results. To solve this, **Genie Ontology** combines explicit business definitions with everyday work context, ensuring that answers reflect real corporate metrics like how finance defines net retention.

Through new integrations, Genie now operates natively inside Microsoft Teams for real-time collaboration, the Azure Databricks Genie plugin for Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Chat, an Excel Add-in for direct workbook analysis, and Microsoft Copilot Studio. Security and compliance are managed through Unity Catalog, which enforces individual user data permissions, and Unity Gateway, which provides administrators with centralized budget controls, traces, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) policies.

en.title: Merck Scraps Centerpiece of $2.7B ArQule Buy After Late-Stage Safety Concerns
en.summary: Merck is ending development of the oral BTK inhibitor nemtabrutinib after a benefit-risk review by an external data monitoring committee, leading to the cancellation of multiple **Phase 3 studies** under its BELLWAVE program. The drug was the **core asset** of Merck's $2.7 billion acquisition of ArQule in late 2019, dealing a major blow to the pharma giant's efforts to enter the non-covalent **BTK inhibitor race**.
en.full_summary:
According to BioSpace, Merck is completely shutting down its BELLWAVE clinical development program for nemtabrutinib (also known as MK-1026 or ARQ 531) following a recommendation from an external data monitoring committee. The committee reviewed findings from the late-stage BELLWAVE-011 trial in untreated chronic lymphocytic leukemia and small lymphocytic lymphoma, concluding that the potential **benefits might not outweigh the risks**. Consequently, Merck is also terminating the BELLWAVE-008 and BELLWAVE-010 trials.

Originally acquired as the centerpiece of the **$2.7 billion ArQule buy** at the end of 2019, nemtabrutinib was meant to establish Merck in the non-covalent BTK inhibitor space, where competitors like Eli Lilly have already secured regulatory approvals with drugs like Jaypirca. This discontinuation comes as Merck prepares for upcoming **patent expiries for Keytruda** starting in 2028, which puts billions in revenue at risk, though analysts remain generally optimistic about its other pipeline candidates.

zh.title: 默沙东因后期安全性隐患放弃27亿美元收购ArQule的核心产品
zh.summary: 在外部数据监测委员会进行收益风险评估后，默沙东决定终止口服BTK抑制剂nemtabrutinib的开发，并取消了其BELLWAVE计划下的多项**三期临床试验**。该药物是默沙东在2019年底以27亿美元收购ArQule时的**核心资产**，这一挫折对其进军非共价**BTK抑制剂**领域的宏伟计划构成了重大打击。
zh.full_summary:
据BioSpace报道，在收到外部数据监测委员会的建议后，默沙东决定全面关闭nemtabrutinib（又称MK-1026或ARQ 531）的BELLWAVE临床开发计划。该委员会在审查了未接受过治疗的慢性淋巴细胞白血病/小淋巴细胞淋巴瘤患者的BELLWAVE-011后期试验结果后，认为该药物的**潜在收益可能无法超过风险**。因此，默沙东决定终止包括该试验在内的多项**后期研究**。

该药物作为2019年底**27亿美元收购ArQule**的核心资产，原本承载着默沙东切入非共价BTK抑制剂赛道的希望。在此之前，礼来等竞争对手已凭Jaypirca等药物率先获批上市。此次研发终止正值默沙东全力应对2028年开始的**Keytruda专利到期**危机之际，尽管分析师对其其他产品线仍保持乐观，但这无疑是一次沉重打击。

en.title: Major Clean Energy Deals Announced at RE+ Trade Show
en.summary: During the RE+ trade show in Las Vegas, major clean energy companies announced massive battery storage deals and acquisitions. **Samsung SDI secured a 16GWh supply agreement** with Jupiter Power, EQT acquired BESS developer Flatiron Energy, and **Canadian Solar's e-Storage sealed a 1.43GWh deal** with X-Elio. These moves highlight surging market demand for large-scale energy storage in the US and globally.
en.full_summary:
As the RE+ clean energy trade show unfolds in Las Vegas, several significant transactions have reshaped the battery energy storage system (BESS) landscape. 

## Samsung SDI's Massive LFP Deal
Samsung SDI announced a multi-year, 16GWh lithium iron phosphate battery supply agreement with Jupiter Power, running for three years from 2029. **The batteries will be manufactured in Indiana**, leveraging Samsung SDI's domestic production lines. This brings Jupiter Power's total booked orders with Samsung SDI to approximately 27GWh.

## EQT Acquires Flatiron Energy
Private equity firm EQT's energy transition infrastructure arm reached an agreement to acquire US utility-scale BESS developer Flatiron Energy from Hull Street Energy. **Flatiron boasts a 24GWh total pipeline** across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic US, reinforcing EQT's growing global footprint in energy storage alongside its previous investments in Statera and Ju:niz Energy.

## Canadian Solar Expands Storage Footprint
Canadian Solar's BESS subsidiary, e-Storage, signed a 590MW/1,430MWh deal with global developer X-Elio to supply systems for five projects in the US and Australia. **The agreement includes 22-year long-term service agreements**, underscoring Canadian Solar's strategic pivot as its storage shipments surge while traditional photovoltaic module shipments decline.

zh.title: 美国清洁能源展会RE+期间密集官宣多项重大合作

随着美国最大清洁能源展会RE+在拉斯维加斯开幕，多项重磅电池储能交易和收购案接连落地，引发行业广泛关注。

en.title: MIT researchers design Lego-like blocks to cut building emissions
en.summary: According to MIT Advanced Manufacturing: MIT researchers have developed **interlocking lattice blocks** called voxels that allow inexpensive, imprecise robots to build strong, precise structures. This approach aims to reduce the construction industry's **carbon emissions** by making material-efficient building methods practically viable.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Advanced Manufacturing:

The construction industry contributes heavily to global greenhouse gas emissions partly because buildings consume excessive materials. While engineers know how to design structurally efficient buildings, producing and installing custom parts remains prohibitively expensive. Traditional digital fabrication methods like 3D printing, meanwhile, require extremely high precision and costly machinery. 

To solve this, MIT researcher Miana Smith inverted the logic by building complex blocks that absorb errors, comparing the concept to Lego bricks where simple pieces prevent error accumulation. Her team developed larger, internally connected lattice voxels that enable cheap robots with high margins of error to assemble load-bearing structures. According to Smith, this method could cut embodied carbon emissions by roughly 80 percent compared to standard concrete construction, and the team is currently collaborating on housing projects and pursuing a startup focused on sustainable concrete.

zh.title: 麻省理工学院研究人员设计乐高式积木以减少建筑碳排放
zh.summary: 据MIT Advanced Manufacturing发布的信息：麻省理工学院研究人员开发了一种名为体素的**咬合式格状积木**，能让价格低廉、精度不足的机器人搭建出坚固且精确的结构。这种方法旨在通过使节约材料的建筑方式在实际中可行，从而减少建筑行业的**碳排放**。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Advanced Manufacturing发布的信息：

建筑行业之所以产生大量温室气体，很大一部分原因在于建筑物消耗了过多材料。虽然工程师知道如何设计出结构高效的建筑，但定制部件的生产和安装成本依然高昂。与此同时，像3D打印这样的传统数字制造方法则需要极高的精度和昂贵的机械设备。

为了解决这个问题，麻省理工学院研究人员米亚纳·史密斯逆向思维，制造出能够吸收误差的复杂积木，并将这一概念比作乐高积木——即通过简单的零件来防止误差累积。她的团队开发出体积更大、内部相互连接的格状体素，使容错率高且价格便宜的机器人能够组装承重结构。史密斯估计，与标准混凝土施工相比，这种方法可将隐含碳排放量减少约80%，目前其实验室正开展住房项目合作，并正在推进专注于可持续混凝土的初创公司。

en.title: CrewAI v1.15.42: Optional ChromaDB and Qdrant Defaults
en.summary: CrewAI released version 1.15.42, a popular framework for orchestrating **AI agents**. This update makes **ChromaDB** an optional dependency and defaults knowledge storage to **local Qdrant**. It also delivers multiple bug fixes for tool selection, JSON data handling, and security vulnerability patching.
en.full_summary:
## Overview of New Features

CrewAI has rolled out version 1.15.42, bringing significant adjustments to its storage architecture and agent capabilities. A major highlight is making **ChromaDB an optional extra**, allowing developers to leaner installations. Additionally, the framework now **defaults knowledge storage to local Qdrant**, decoupling storage dependencies and streamlining local vector search configurations.

## Bug Fixes and Enhancements

The release addresses numerous operational stability issues. It includes fixes for storing **output_json values properly as JSON** to prevent date formatting bugs, ensuring each Flow receives a distinct ID, and honoring max execution time limits accurately. Furthermore, it introduces security updates such as raising the soupsieve floor to version 4.0 to mitigate **CVE-2026-126190**, and guarantees robust UTF-8 file reading across project helpers and environment files.

## Installation and Usage

Developers can update or install the latest version via Python's package management tools. For projects leveraging vector databases or complex agentic workflows, reviewing the updated ChromaDB and Qdrant configurations is recommended to ensure smooth execution.

en.title: Maryland students sue after AI gun detection mistakes Doritos for a firearm
en.summary: Four Maryland students have filed a lawsuit after an **AI gun-detection** system mistook a bag of Doritos for a firearm. The false alert led armed police to **detain and handcuff** the teenagers, leaving them traumatized and fearing for their lives.
en.full_summary:
According to the lawsuit filed by the Lawyers' Committee for Civil Rights Under Law, the incident occurred after football practice when students were waiting for rides outside a Maryland high school. Omnilert's AI gun-detection system flagged a bag of Doritos as a firearm with 90% confidence, prompting six police cruisers to arrive with flashing lights and armed officers. The students were ordered to their knees, handcuffed, and searched.

Legal documents state that Maryland's office of the inspector general for education found over 99% of alerts from this system in Baltimore County Public Schools were false positives. The lawsuit targets Omnilert, the local police, the school board, and the principal, alleging unlawful detention, while highlighting the severe emotional distress suffered by the students.

zh.title: 马里兰州学生起诉：AI安防系统将多力多滋薯片误认为枪支引发警察持枪搜查
zh.summary: 马里兰州四名学生因AI安防系统将一包薯片误认为枪支而遭到武装警察扣押，目前已正式提起诉讼。这起因**人工智能误报**引发的事件导致学生被**戴上手铐**，身心受到严重创伤。
zh.full_summary:
根据民权律师委员会代表学生提交的诉讼文件，这起事件发生在去年秋天的一所马里兰州高中外。当时学生们刚结束橄榄球训练，在校外等候家长接送。Omnilert公司的**AI安防系统**以90%的置信度将一包多力多滋薯片标记为枪支，随即引来了六辆闪烁警灯的警车和多名荷枪实弹的警察，学生们被勒令跪地、搜身并戴上手铐。

诉讼文件显示，马里兰州教育监察长办公室此前发现，该系统在巴尔的摩县公立学校的报警准确率极低，**误报率超过99%**。该诉讼将Omnilert公司、当地警方、教育委员会及学校校长全部列为被告，指控其非法拘禁，并指出了这场乌龙事件给未成年人带来的长久心理阴影。

en.title: BMS Alzheimer’s drug shows promise but safety questions remain
en.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb revealed early clinical data showing its drug Cobenfy reduced hallucinations and delusions in Alzheimer’s patients. However, analysts pointed out that **safety events** and high rates of side effects still leave important questions unanswered ahead of more definitive **2027 results**.
en.full_summary:
Bristol Myers Squibb presented early data from its Phase 3 ADEPT program at the CTAD conference, testing the drug KarXT (marketed as Cobenfy) for psychosis associated with Alzheimer’s disease. Data from two studies, ADEPT-1 and ADEPT-3, showed improvements in symptoms like hallucinations and delusions. 

However, **treatment-emergent adverse events** affected over half of the patients, reaching 56.6% in one study and 65% in the other, raising tolerability concerns. Analysts from Truist Securities noted that the current data lacks a placebo control and does not address the main trial endpoint of relapse prevention. The definitive randomized results are expected in **2027**.

zh.title: 百时美施贵宝阿茨海默症新药初现成效，但安全性仍存疑问
zh.summary: 百时美施贵宝公布的早期临床数据显示，其药物 Cobenfy 能够减轻阿茨海默症患者的幻觉和妄想。不过，分析师指出，在等待 2027 年更确切的试验结果之前，该药的**不良事件**和较高的副作用发生率仍然带来了不少疑问。
zh.full_summary:
百时美施贵宝在阿茨海默症临床试验（CTAD）会议上公布了其三期 ADEPT 项目的早期数据，该项目旨在测试 KarXT（商品名为 Cobenfy）用于治疗阿茨海默症相关的精神病症状。来自 ADEPT-1 和 ADEPT-3 两项研究的数据显示，患者的幻觉和妄想等症状有所改善。

不过，超过一半的患者出现了**治疗期间不良事件**，在其中一项研究中比例达到 56.6%，另一项则高达 65%，这引发了外界对药物耐受性的担忧。Truist 证券的分析师指出，目前的数据缺乏安慰剂对照，也未能回答关于防止复发的主要试验终点问题。更具决定性的随机对照结果预计将在 **2027 年**揭晓。

en.title: What industrial drone deployments reveal about real-world autonomy challenges
en.summary: Deploying autonomous drones in industrial facilities exposes real-world challenges where subsystems like navigation, obstacle detection, and flight control interact unpredictably. ZenaDrone contributor Jonathan Metzelaar explains that metal structures, signal blockages, and wind gusts create simultaneous disturbances that lab tests rarely capture. Reliable industrial autonomy requires understanding how uncertainties propagate across the entire system rather than relying on isolated component performance.
en.full_summary:
Industrial facilities present complex environments that severely test autonomous drone navigation. GNSS signals can be blocked or distorted by metallic structures, while repetitive pipes and reflective surfaces confuse visual and lidar sensors. Furthermore, wind gusts near buildings introduce aerodynamic disturbances that challenge flight controllers.

ZenaDrone contributor Jonathan Metzelaar notes that autonomy performance depends heavily on the interactions between subsystems whose assumptions are rarely independent. Localization errors can corrupt obstacle coordinates, and processing latency directly translates into physical braking distance, meaning an obstacle avoidance system must be judged on end-to-end timing rather than detection range alone. Additionally, successfully flying a route does not guarantee that collected inspection data, such as thermal imagery or photogrammetry, will be accurate or repeatable.

To ensure safe and reliable deployments, engineering teams must move beyond isolated subsystem tests and evaluate their systems under combined failure scenarios. This includes defining measurable acceptance criteria for localization, latency, and failure recovery, while maintaining clear operational boundaries and supervisory human oversight.

zh.title: 工业无人机实地部署揭示的真实自主飞行挑战
zh.summary: 在工业场地上部署自主无人机，会暴露出实验室里很难遇到的真实挑战，比如导航、避障和飞控等子系统会产生意料之外的连锁反应。ZenaDrone 的撰稿人 Jonathan Metzelaar 指出，金属建筑、信号遮挡和阵风会同时干扰无人机，单一组件表现好不代表整体系统就安全。要实现可靠的工业自主飞行，工程师必须弄清楚误差是如何在整个系统里蔓延的，而不是只盯着单个零件的性能。
zh.full_summary:
工业环境充满了各种复杂因素，对自主无人机的导航能力构成了严峻考验。金属建筑会阻挡或干扰卫星定位信号，而密集的管道和反光表面又会让视觉和激光雷达传感器分不清方向。此外，建筑物附近的阵风会产生复杂的空气动力干扰，给飞行控制器带来麻烦。

ZenaDrone 撰稿人 Jonathan Metzelaar 指出，无人机的自主飞行表现取决于各个子系统之间的相互影响，而这些子系统往往无法彼此独立。定位错误可能会导致避障坐标出现偏差，处理延迟也会直接转化为实际的刹车距离，这意味着评估避障系统不能只看探测距离，还得看整体的反应时间。此外，顺利飞完整条路线并不代表收集到的巡检数据（如热成像或摄影测量）就一定准确或可重复。

为了确保部署安全可靠，工程团队不能只在实验室里测试单个组件，必须在多种故障交织的场景下进行综合评估。这包括为定位、延迟和故障恢复制定可量化的验收标准，同时划定明确的操作边界并保留人类监督的介入机制。

en.title: Soft robotic suit helps older adults stand up and walk more easily
en.summary: Researchers at the Technical University of Munich have developed a **soft, lightweight exosuit** that uses machine learning and artificial tendons to help older adults stand up and walk. In a study of ten older participants, the suit helped them complete **sit-and-stand cycles faster** and reduced walking energy costs, while users still felt in full control of their movements.
en.full_summary:
## How the exosuit works
Developed by researchers at the Technical University of Munich, the exosuit functions like a wearable system with thigh straps, a waist belt, and artificial tendons connected to a backpack-like motor unit. **Sensors on the thighs** track leg movements in real time, and a machine learning algorithm triggers the motor to pull on the tendons, providing hip support exactly when the user stands up or walks.

## Study results and user feedback
In tests involving ten older adults aged 69 to 85, the suit improved mobility significantly. Participants completed **up to four additional sit-and-stand cycles** in one minute, and their average walking metabolic cost dropped by 14%. According to researcher Dr. Xiaohui Zhang, users also reported a high sense of personal agency, feeling that the suit acted like a regular piece of clothing rather than an intrusive machine.

zh.title: 软体机器人外骨骼帮老年人更轻松地站起来和走路
zh.summary: 慕尼黑工业大学的研究人员开发了一款**轻便的软体外骨骼服装**，利用机器学习和人造肌腱来帮助老年人站立和行走。在一项针对十名老年参与者的研究中，这款服装帮助他们**更快地完成起坐循环**并减少了走路时的体力消耗，同时使用者依然觉得完全能自主控制自己的动作。
zh.full_summary:
## 外骨骼是如何工作的
由慕尼黑工业大学研究人员开发的这款外骨骼穿起来就像一件衣服，配有大腿带、腰带以及连接在背包式电机单元上的**人造肌腱**。大腿上的传感器会实时追踪腿部动作，机器学习算法则会在用户站立或行走时精确触发电机拉动肌腱，提供髋部支撑。

## 研究结果与用户反馈
在涉及十名 69 岁至 85 岁老年人的测试中，这款服装显著改善了他们的行动能力。参与者在一分钟内**多完成了最多四次起坐循环**，且步行平均代谢消耗降低了 14%。据研究员 Xiaohui Zhang 称，用户还报告了极高的自主掌控感，感觉这套设备穿在身上就像普通衣服一样自然。

en.title: World's First Halal-Certified Cultivated Meat Launches in the US
en.summary: According to Good Food Institute APAC: UPSIDE Foods has launched the **world's first** halal-certified cultivated chicken product in the U.S. after evaluation by Circle H International. This milestone is crucial because **over a billion people** worldwide follow halal dietary standards, opening up vital pathways for cultivated meat to enter broader markets.
en.full_summary:
According to Good Food Institute APAC:

Following fatwas from Islamic authorities in Singapore, South Korea, and Malaysia recognizing cultivated meat under certain conditions, UPSIDE Foods has secured the first official halal certification for a cultivated meat product. Circle H International, whose standards are recognized globally by major institutions including the Organization of Islamic Cooperation, completed a year-long evaluation of the product.

To meet market demands, UPSIDE's new formulation combines cultivated chicken with plant-based ingredients like soy protein isolate and pea fibre, with cultivated meat making up a double-digit percentage of the final product. The company reports that its revamped production system can produce **over 1 million pounds** of chicken annually on less than half an acre of land. Early consumer reviews at participating restaurants like Los Angeles' Chimmelier described the product as crispy and delicious.

zh.title: 全球首款获得清真认证的细胞培养肉在美国上市
zh.summary: 据Good Food Institute APAC发布的信息：UPSIDE Foods 推出了全球首款获得清真认证的细胞培养肉鸡肉产品，并通过了国际清真权威机构 Circle H 的评估。这一进展意义重大，因为全球有**超过十亿人**遵循清真饮食标准，为细胞培养肉进入更广阔的市场铺平了道路。
zh.full_summary:
据Good Food Institute APAC发布的信息：

继新加坡、韩国和马来的伊斯兰权威机构在特定条件下承认细胞培养肉合规之后，UPSIDE Foods 成功获得了首个针对细胞培养肉产品的官方清真认证。国际清真权威机构 Circle H 经过长达一年的评估，最终批准了该认证，其标准在伊斯兰合作组织等全球主要机构中广受认可。

为了迎合市场需求，UPSIDE 的最新配方将细胞培养鸡肉与大豆分离蛋白、豌豆纤维等植物成分相结合，其中细胞培养肉占成品的双位数百分比。该公司表示，其改进后的生产系统能够在不到半英亩的土地上，每年生产**超过 100 万磅**的鸡肉。洛杉矶 Chimmelier 等合作餐厅的早期消费者反馈称，该产品口感酥脆、美味多汁。

en.title: ESA Awards OHB €102M Contract for ClearSpace-1 Debris Removal Mission
en.summary: The European Space Agency has awarded German satellite maker OHB a **€102 million contract** to build the ClearSpace-1 spacecraft, which will capture and remove the retired **Proba-1 satellite**. The mission has faced previous delays and redesigns after its original target was struck by debris, and is now scheduled to **launch in 2030**.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Restructuring
The European Space Agency signed the contract on 17 November at Space Tech Expo Europe in Bremen, marking the start of the implementation phase for ClearSpace-1. Originally awarded to a consortium led by Swiss startup ClearSpace in December 2020, the mission underwent major changes after its initial target was struck by space debris in August 2023. This forced a redesign, selecting Proba-1 as the new target and making OHB the **prime contractor**.

## Launch Details
The mission's launch plans have also shifted over time. While it was once slated for a Vega C rocket in 2026, technical papers and presentations point toward a dedicated microlauncher flight. An OHB presentation featured an illustration of the **RFA ONE rocket**, which is notable since OHB holds a majority stake in its developer, Rocket Factory Augsburg. However, neither ESA nor OHB has officially confirmed this launch vehicle, with the overall mission timeline now targeted for **2030**.

zh.title: 欧空局向德国 OHB 授出 1.02 亿欧元合同，推进 ClearSpace-1 太空垃圾清理任务
zh.summary: 欧洲空间局向德国卫星制造商 OHB 授予了一份价值 **1.02亿欧元** 的合同，用于建造 ClearSpace-1 航天器，以捕获并清除退役的 **Proba-1 卫星**。该任务此前因原定目标被太空 debris 撞击而经历过重新设计与延期，目前预计将于 **2030年发射**。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与项目重组
欧洲空间局于 11 月 17 日在德国不莱梅举行的欧洲太空技术博览会上签署了这项合同，标志着 ClearSpace-1 任务正式进入实施阶段。该项目最初于 2020 年 12 月授予瑞士初创公司 ClearSpace 领导的财团，但在 2023 年 8 月，其原定清理的目标被太空垃圾撞击，迫使项目进行重新设计，将目标更换为 Proba-1 卫星，并由 OHB 接任 **主承包商**。

## 发射安排与进展
该任务的发射计划也经历了多次调整。虽然最初计划于 2026 年使用织女星 C 型火箭发射，但相关技术文件和演示文稿显示，任务将改用专门的微型运载火箭。OHB 的演示文稿中曾出现 **RFA ONE 火箭** 的插图，这引人注目，因为 OHB 持有该火箭开发商 Rocket Factory Augsburg 的多数股权。不过，欧空局和 OHB 均未公开确认最终的运载火箭，目前整个任务的发射时间窗口已调整至 **2030年**。

en.title: Google brings the Gemini app to lower-memory Android devices
en.summary: According to Google AI: Google announces that the **Gemini app** is now rolling out to lower-memory **Android (Go edition)** devices. By re-architecting the application, Google aims to bring its personal AI assistant to hundreds of millions of users who previously relied on basic voice commands due to hardware limitations.
en.full_summary:
According to Google AI:

According to Angus Logan, Builder for the Gemini App at Google, the company has re-architected the Gemini app so that its core experience can run smoothly on lower-memory Android devices. This update targets hundreds of millions of global users whose everyday internet and business connections rely on budget hardware.

With this release, eligible devices gain access to features like **Gemini Live**, allowing users to talk things through or practice for interviews out loud in over 45 languages. Users can also utilize their device cameras to translate documents, or create custom images. Google notes that the app can be downloaded via Google Play, accessed by holding the power button on supported phones, or found preloaded on upcoming devices from partners such as Transsion.

zh.title: 谷歌将 Gemini 应用带入低内存安卓手机
zh.summary: 据Google AI发布的信息：谷歌宣布 **Gemini 应用** 正式登陆低内存的 **Android (Go edition)** 设备。通过重新架构软件，谷歌让这款个人AI助手得以进入那些此前因硬件限制只能使用基础语音命令的广大用户群体中。
zh.full_summary:
据Google AI发布的信息：

据谷歌 Gemini 应用开发团队的 Angus Logan 介绍，谷歌对 Gemini 应用进行了重新架构，使其核心体验能够在低内存安卓设备上流畅运行。此次更新主要面向全球数亿依靠入门级硬件进行日常生活、学习和商业连接的用户。

随着此次发布，符合条件的设备将能够使用 **Gemini Live** 等功能，支持用户用 45 种以上的语言进行语音对话或练习面试。此外，用户还可以通过手机相机翻译文件或生成定制图片。谷歌表示，用户可以通过 Google Play 下载该应用、在支持的手机上长按电源键唤醒，或者在传音等合作伙伴即将推出的新设备上直接体验预装版本。

en.title: Revopoint MIRACO 2 3D Scanner Automates Scan-to-CAD Workflows with AI Agents
en.summary: Revopoint is launching the MIRACO 2 standalone 3D scanner, featuring an AI-driven workflow system called **Revo Agents** designed to automate the transition from raw scan data to CAD models. The handheld device packs an **8-core CPU** and a 6-core NPU, offering up to six scanning modes and a single-frame accuracy of up to 0.02 mm.
en.full_summary:
Shenzhen-based 3D scanner manufacturer Revopoint announced the upcoming Kickstarter launch of its MIRACO 2 3D scanner. The standalone 960-gram device features an 8-core CPU, a 6-core NPU, and a 6-inch 2K AMOLED touchscreen, allowing users to handle depth computation and point cloud processing on the go. According to Revopoint, the device supports six distinct scanning modes, reaching single-frame accuracies of up to **0.02 mm** in multi-line laser mode.

A key addition is Revo Agents, an **AI-native engineering co-pilot** that lets users direct complex 3D operations using natural language commands. The system aims to streamline point cloud fusion and scan-to-CAD conversions while keeping user data secure through a local sandbox environment and optional offline functionality.

For advanced use cases, the scanner can connect to a PC via Wi-Fi 6 or USB-C to unlock physically scaled **3D Gaussian Splatting** for XR applications. The super early bird pricing for the Kickstarter campaign starts at $1,425.

zh.title: Revopoint 推出 MIRACO 2 三维扫描仪，用 AI 助手自动搞定扫描到 CAD 的繁琐流程
zh.summary: Revopoint 即将推出 MIRACO 2 独立式 3D 扫描仪，它最大的亮点是搭载了名为 **Revo Agents** 的 AI 驱动工作流系统，能自动把扫描数据转化成 CAD 模型。这款手持设备内置了 **8 核 CPU** 和 NPU，提供多达六种扫描模式，单帧精度最高可达 0.02 毫米。
zh.full_summary:
总部位于深圳的 3D 扫描仪制造商 Revopoint 宣布将在 Kickstarter 上发布其新款 MIRACO 2 3D 扫描仪。这款重 960 克的便携设备搭载了 8 核 CPU、6 核 NPU 以及 6 英寸 2K AMOLED 触控屏，无需连接电脑即可在户外进行深度计算和点云处理。据 Revopoint 称，该设备支持六种扫描模式，在多线激光模式下的单帧精度最高可达 **0.02 毫米**。

该产品的一大突破是引入了 Revo Agents，这是一个 **AI 原生工程助手**，允许用户通过自然语言指令来指挥复杂的 3D 操作。该系统旨在简化点云融合和扫描转 CAD 的流程，并通过本地沙盒环境和离线功能来保障用户的数据安全。

在连接电脑的高阶模式下，扫描仪还能解锁物理缩放的 **3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）** 功能，用于生成 XR 应用所需的 1:1 模型。其 Kickstarter 众筹的超级早鸟价从 1,425 美元起步。

en.title: Nvidia faces short-seller scrutiny over former executive's ties to China
en.summary: Muddy Waters and other short sellers are **scrutinizing Nvidia** over its business in China, pointing to potential ties between a former top executive and a server maker accused of illegal chip shipments. Even so, Nvidia recently reported **strong quarterly revenue** and raised its future growth outlook, while some short sellers unwound their positions.
en.full_summary:
Short-seller firm Muddy Waters published a report questioning whether a former high-ranking Nvidia executive has links to Cenly Chen, a former officer at server maker Supermicro who was named in a shareholder complaint regarding unproven allegations of illicit GPU sales to China. Muddy Waters acknowledged that these civil allegations remain unproven and that Chen has not faced criminal charges. Supermicro pushed back against the claims, stating Chen did not manage its relationship with Nvidia or chip distribution.

This adds to mounting bearish pressure on Nvidia, following similar concerns raised by Michael Burry regarding geographic revenue reporting and a separate report by Culper Research concerning a Singapore-based customer, Megaspeed. US authorities recently confirmed a criminal probe into Megaspeed over potential export-control violations. Despite these headwinds and recent leadership turmoil involving co-founder Jensen Huang, Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of US$115.8 billion, a 103 per cent increase year-on-year, and raised its fiscal 2028 growth outlook.

zh.title: 英伟达因前高管与中国业务的关联遭到空头狙击
zh.summary: 浑水等知名空头机构开始**盯上英伟达**的中国业务，质疑其前高管与一家被指控违规向中国转售芯片的服务器制造商是否存在关联。尽管如此，英伟达近期仍交出了一份**亮眼的季度营收**答卷，并上调了未来的业绩增长预期。
zh.full_summary:
知名做空机构浑水发布报告，质疑英伟达前高管是否与超微电脑（Supermicro）前高管陈岑存在关联。此前的一起股东诉讼曾指控陈岑涉及违规向中国销售GPU的指控，但浑水承认相关民事指控尚未证实，陈岑也未受到刑事指控。超微电脑则公开回应称，陈岑并未负责管理该公司与英伟达的关系或芯片分发工作。

在此之前，迈克尔·伯里及Culper Research等空头也对英伟达的中国业务及新加坡客户Megaspeed提出了质疑，美国司法部目前正对Megaspeed涉嫌违反出口管制展开刑事调查。尽管面临空头压力及联合创始人黄仁勋离职引发的管理层动荡，英伟达最新发布的季度营收仍达到115.8亿美元，同比大增103%，公司并进一步上调了2028财年的增长预期。

en.title: IQM and AMD Demonstrate Hybrid Quantum-GPU Chemistry Workflow
en.summary: IQM and AMD report a **hybrid workflow** that splits molecular calculations between a quantum processor and GPUs. The partners ran tests on **hydrogen molecules** to validate interoperability, though they note it is not a demonstration of quantum advantage.
en.full_summary:
According to IQM Quantum Computers and AMD, the two companies have successfully demonstrated an end-to-end hybrid quantum-classical workflow for computational chemistry. The setup splits molecular ground-state energy calculations between IQM's 20-qubit superconducting **IQM Garnet** processor and AMD Instinct GPUs utilizing the open-source ROCm software stack.

The workflow applies **Quantum-Selected Configuration Interaction** to handle memory scaling limits. The quantum processor prepares trial circuits and samples bitstrings, while the AMD GPU filters samples and executes matrix diagonalization using JAX on ROCm. The teams validated this pipeline across 17 bond lengths on physical hardware and published the code as an open-source Jupyter notebook.

zh.title: IQM与AMD联合演示量子与GPU混合化学计算工作流
zh.summary: IQM与AMD联合展示了一套**混合计算工作流**，将分子计算任务分配给量子处理器与GPU共同完成。双方在**氢分子**测试中验证了系统的兼容性，并明确这并非量子优越性的演示。
zh.full_summary:
据IQM量子计算公司与AMD称，双方成功演示了一套用于计算化学的端到端混合量子经典工作流。该方案将分子的基态能量计算任务拆分，分别交由IQM的20比特超导量子处理器**IQM Garnet**以及运行开源ROCm软件栈的AMD Instinct GPU共同处理。

该工作流采用了**量子筛选构型相互作用**方法来绕过内存扩展的限制。量子处理器负责准备试探电路并采样比特串，而AMD GPU则负责过滤样本，并利用ROCm上的JAX执行矩阵对角化。两家公司在物理硬件上针对17个键长进行了整条管线的验证，并将相关代码作为开源Jupyter笔记本发布。
